name: Oil & Gas
description: Flow intelligence that performs where pressure, precision, and uptime are non-negotiable. From upstream volatility to downstream complexity, Rotex enables control that adapts, responds, and delivers.
sectionTitle: Supporting the Control Points Behind Every Confident Shift
overview: Oil and gas operations run in some of the world's most demanding and safety-critical environments across upstream wellheads, midstream pipelines, and downstream refineries. The volatile nature of hydrocarbons, combined with complex extraction and processing systems, creates conditions where even minor deviations can lead to severe operational, environmental, and financial consequences.  From offshore platforms to remote drilling sites, operations face constant challenges including extreme pressures, high temperatures, and limited accessibility. These conditions place immense stress on equipment and demand systems that can perform reliably without interruption. Downtime is not a delay it is a direct loss of safety, output, and revenue. At the same time, stringent regulatory requirements and increasing environmental scrutiny require continuous improvements in safety, control, and operational efficiency.  Rotex addresses these challenges through a systems-led approach to flow control, purpose-engineered for the demands of oil and gas. Solenoid valves, actuators, positioners, and electrohydraulic systems work together as an integrated intelligence layer within the process. This enables faster response, precise control, and fail-safe operation across upstream, midstream, and downstream environments.  The result is safer operations, improved reliability, and consistent performance helping operators run critical assets safely, efficiently, and without compromise across every stage of oil and gas production and processing.

name: Automotive
description: Water and wastewater treatment operations rely on consistent, large-scale flow control across raw water intake, treatment, distribution, and effluent management. Process automation must perform reliably with low to medium pressures, corrosive media, and demanding regulatory requirements.
sectionTitle: Engineered for Speed, Precision, and Scale
overview: The automotive industry demands systems that are highly reliable, compact, and efficient. From assembly lines to testing systems, operations depend on repeatability, speed, and seamless automation. When it comes to critical flow control applications, performance, consistency, and precision are essential.  With extensive experience across diverse automotive applications, Rotex stands out as a trusted partner. Its integrated R&D and manufacturing capabilities enable the development of advanced, application-specific solutions. Rotex has delivered patented innovations tailored to the evolving needs of the automotive sector, including auto drain valves for water fuel separators, hydrocarbon modules for DPF regeneration compliant with EURO 6 standards, and ultra-low noise solenoid valves for Level 3 ADAS sensor cleaning systems.  Supported by world-class manufacturing facilities, Rotex produces high volumes with exceptional precision, meeting stringent quality standards such as cleanliness and leak tightness.  Whatever the requirement, Rotex combines over 57 years of engineering expertise with strong design and manufacturing capabilities to deliver reliable, high-performance solenoid valve and pneumatic solutions for the automotive industry.

name: Rail
description: In rail systems, performance is measured in safety and consistency. Rotex delivers control you can depend on, engineered for safety, reliability, and continuous operation.
sectionTitle: Control That Keeps Rail Systems Moving
overview:
"Railways operate in environments where safety, reliability, and continuous performance are critical. Systems must function seamlessly under constant vibration, varying environmental conditions, and high-duty cycles, where even minor failures can impact operations at scale.
Rotex supports this ecosystem with precision-engineered solenoid valves and control systems that ensure dependable performance across both diesel and electric locomotives. From powering the prime movers of diesel engines to enabling accurate pantograph control in electric locomotives, Rotex solutions are built for consistency and durability. Today, a significant majority of Indian locomotives rely on Rotex for their engine solenoid valve requirements, reflecting deep trust in performance and reliability.

Our solutions also contribute to safety-critical systems designed to prevent operational risks such as collisions, ensuring better control and responsiveness across rail networks. Engineered for long lifecycle performance and minimal maintenance, Rotex helps make rail travel safer, faster, and more efficient."

name: Aerospace & Defence
description: Ultra-precise, lightweight flow control for aerospace ground support, fuel handling, and hydraulic test rigs where failure is not an option.
overview:
The aerospace and defence industry demands the highest levels of precision, reliability, and performance. While the number of components may be limited, each one must be engineered to exacting standards using advanced materials, rigorous validation processes, and compact, lightweight designs.  

Rotex understands these requirements and has been supporting the industry with high-precision flow control solutions. Our systems have contributed to multiple Indian space missions, with applications across engine testing facilities and launch infrastructure. These environments require absolute reliability, and our solutions are built to perform under the most demanding conditions.  

Our capability to develop critical, application-specific valves continues to push us to innovate and deliver beyond conventional limits. The development of our CTIS system reflects this commitment to engineering excellence.  

Recognized by customers such as Ashok Leyland for delivering high-performance solutions within short development timelines, Rotex combines precision engineering with speed and reliability to meet the evolving needs of the aerospace and defence sector.

name: Process Industries
description: Industrial automation and fluid control solutions built for industries where consistency, control, and uptime define performance. From raw material handling to final output, every movement is engineered to respond.
overview: Continuous process industries operate where downtime is not just a delay, it is a direct loss of productivity, safety, and revenue. From refineries and chemical plants to cement and pharmaceutical facilities, operations run under extreme conditions involving high temperatures, pressures, hazardous environments, and high-cycle requirements. Even minor inefficiencies or failures in control systems can disrupt entire production lines.  Rotex is built for these critical environments. With proven expertise across high-temperature applications exceeding 250°C, high-pressure systems up to 400 bar, and high-cycle operations running up to 20 cycles per minute, Rotex delivers reliability where it matters most. Our solenoid valves, positioners, and electro-hydraulic actuators work as an integrated system to ensure stable, responsive, and safe operations.  From enabling faster changeovers in multi-product chemical plants to optimizing air consumption in over 80 percent of cement plants, Rotex consistently enhances efficiency and performance.  With over 57 years of engineering expertise and a track record of solving more than 200 complex industrial challenges, Rotex remains the partner of choice when reliability is critical and failure is not an option.
